purpose: Teach: クイーン/神戸大学/日本テレビ/ヤマハ/セルビア/養老/慶應義塾/中国共産党

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがクイーンのレコードを集められた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to collect Queen records.
lines.style: Gentle, reaching back into memory. Soft attack. Warm nostalgia in the voice, almost surprised at the clarity of the recollection. Patient pacing, as if turning the memory over in his hands.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、神戸大学にお勤めだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather worked at Kobe University, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright correction, gently redirecting. She's not arguing, just steering him back. A patient kind of fondness underneath. Light, almost playful lilt on 'dear' — the familiar cadence of long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが日本テレビのドラマを観てらした
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to watch Nippon Television dramas.
lines.style: Same reaching quality as before. He's gathering these details like gifts. Quiet conviction that these small things matter. No rush. The voice of someone who has earned the right to dwell in the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ヤマハの楽器をお買いになったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather bought Yamaha instruments, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Another gentle redirect, but warmer this time — she's smiling at him now. Not correcting so much as coaxing him back to their shared past. Slight musical rise at the end, inviting him to remember with her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが旧ユーゴ崩壊時にセルビアの報道に注目された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he paid close attention to Serbian news during the Yugoslav collapse.
lines.style: More deliberate now. He's working to hold onto these specifics. Voice slightly more measured, as if concentrating. The gravity of his effort is present but not burdensome. Still reaching, still tender.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、養老の滝に温泉旅行に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather took a hot spring trip to Yoro Falls, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmer now, almost laughing softly with him. She's meeting him in these memories. The 'dear' carries real affection — not a correction anymore, just a woman holding his hand through time. Bright, steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが慶應義塾大学に進学された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he enrolled at Keio University.
lines.style: The voice settles into a kind of peace here. The recollection is clearer now. Quiet certainty underneath the gentleness. He's not reaching so much as simply stating what was. Slow, assured pacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、中国共産党のニュースを毎晩ご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather watched the Chinese Communist Party news every evening, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: A final gentle redirect, almost conspiratorial. She's smiling at something private they both know. The 'dear' has deepened now — it's become a quiet expression of everything they've shared. Very soft, intimate close.
